cash_debit: quantity * already effective Frozen entry price
cash_release: quantity * effective final sell price only on admissible valid fill AND authorized cash-known event; no release on intent, missing source or unexecutable deadline.
funded_subset: No allocator before C2 PASS. Cannot remove candidates at Entry using eventual EOD source/exit outcome.
mark_cadence: No new cadence/interpolation/funded-only censoring protocol adopted by this overlay.
missing_accounting: Unresolved obligation stays open and cash stays locked; missing mark yields unknown equity, no fake cash or synthetic MTM.
overnight_failure: Retain unresolved obligation; STOP full comparison when source/market failure prevents unbiased admission.
quantity_rule: full remaining quantity; no partial exit; runtime quantity>0; candidate quantity not funded/not invented
reference_fill_vs_known_at: Separate reference-only counterfactual evidence from runtime cash authorization. Frozen assumed_available_at and actual arrival preserved.
same_time_order: Eligible confirmed EXIT release then ENTRY. No future/unknown cash becomes eligible. Existing clock binding remains unresolved unless proven.
trade_PnL: quantity*(effectiveSell-effectiveEntry); equals cash endpoint minus initial cash for a closed isolated trade.
